problems.message: Category TVL: DefiLlama's free protocol list doesn't mark double-counted or liquid-staking TVL per protocol, so whole categories are left out by rule; the rest adds up to 128.14% of the headline TVL, so category shares are of that total (explained on the Overview)
Snapshot has no space "aave.eth" (listed for Aave by DefiLlama, CoinGecko or watchlist.json), so Aave's votes come from aavedao.eth
